result.summary: The page layout is mostly sound, but the featured restaurant card in 'Popular right now' has a truncated title colliding with the rating, and favorite-button styling is inconsistent between cards.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is cut off mid-word ('Tokumaru Ramei') because the title has no room next to the right-aligned star rating '4.8 (500+)'. This is a vertical list card, not a horizontal carousel edge clip.
issues.suggestion: Give the title a flexible width with the rating in a fixed-width column, and apply single-line ellipsis truncation so the name never appears sliced mid-glyph.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second has a dark/translucent circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon color across all cards, ideally a consistent semi-transparent scrim that guarantees contrast over any image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card's image has a light grey background while the others use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent and the white time pill less legible on the light card.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image treatment (e.g., consistent background or a subtle gradient overlay behind badges) so the time pills always have adequate contrast.
